BEFORE YOUR FIRST WHAT IF

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Do I need to know how to code?

No coding experience is needed to start describing your idea. Refine the generated app through conversation, then review and test it before publishing. You can inspect the source whenever you want.

Are the examples on this page live apps?

They are interactive demonstrations using sample data. Booking requests, shopping bags, and project views stay in this page and reset when you reload. They show possible workflows; they do not create an app or contact a real business.

What makes Atomic different?

Atomic uses Atom, the open-source backend maintained by the same team. It brings identity, data, and permissions together underneath generated apps, alongside verified source history, previews, and frontend publishing.

Can I take my code with me?

Yes. You can browse and download generated source. Downloads don’t include users, business data, or hosting infrastructure. Broader app packaging and deployment choices are on our roadmap.

When can I try it, and what will it cost?

We’re preparing for launch. Email us about your idea to ask about early access. We’ll share availability and final plan details as launch approaches.
